solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Presumably loose clothing right for this occasion

indicators.note: clothing means wrapping around, so the rearranged letters dress the abbreviation for right
loose means let free from its usual order, so the letters of the word before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A guess that baggy clothes would suit some event.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loose' and 'clothing' look like a garment description; they are the anagram and container signals. The surface's loose clothing, pyjamas, suits the occasion too.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleepover gathering where guests wear nightwear is the event the clue's last words point to.

clue.text: Partners put in track finance

indicators.note: put in means inserted, so the bridge pair goes inside the trail word

parts.note: spoor is the track left by an animal
N and S, North and South, are partners at bridge

explanation.surface: Business partners invest in a racetrack.
explanation.definitionFit: To back a venture with money is to fund it, the verb sense.

clue.text: One minus one? Pity that's a lie

indicators.note: minus means taken away, so the numeral letter comes out of the synonym

parts.note: a unit is one
I is the Roman numeral for one
ruth is an old word for pity

explanation.surface: A puzzled sum, one take one, followed by regret that it is false.
explanation.definitionFit: A falsehood is a statement that is not true, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Punter's run off — appropriate when turned over

indicators.note: turned over means flipped end to end, so the pair is read backwards

parts.note: to elope is to run off to marry
to appropriate is to grab

explanation.surface: A gambler has bolted, which seems fitting when beaten.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Punter' looks like a gambler; it is someone propelling a punt, a flat boat, with a long pole. 'Punter's' means the punter's thing.
explanation.definitionFit: The long pole used to push a flat boat along is the tool of someone punting.

clue.text: Closer to caller with every contact

indicators.note: the closer of a word is its final letter

parts.note: each means every

explanation.surface: A phone call nearer to the one ringing, with every connection.
explanation.definitionFit: To get through to someone by phone is to contact them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Old canine tooth's beginning to wobble

indicators.note: to wobble is to shake loose, so these letters are mixed
beginning means the first letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: An aged dog's tooth starts to come loose.
explanation.definitionFit: Something very aged is old, a direct synonym.

clue.text: In a bunch, so unable to take hard hit

indicators.note: unable to take means lacking, so the letter for hard is removed

parts.note: thus means so
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard
to sock someone is to hit them

explanation.surface: Bunched up and so unable to withstand a heavy blow.
explanation.definitionFit: A tuft or clump of grass growing thickly together is a bunch.

clue.text: Pessimist found mobile in Phones 4 U

indicators.note: mobile means able to move, so the letters are rearranged; it is also a pun on the mobile phone shop

parts.note: 4 points to the answer of clue 4 Down

explanation.surface: A gloomy person bought a mobile at a phone shop, Phones 4 U being a former UK phone retailer.
explanation.walkthrough: The number 4 is not a numeral here but stands for the answer to clue 4 Down.
explanation.definitionFit: The German philosopher Arthur of that name is famous for his bleak, pessimistic outlook.

clue.text: Farmer's short drive around banks of the river

indicators.note: around means turned round, so the shortened word is read backwards
short means cut off before its end, so the last letter of the synonym goes

parts.note: to drive is to force or push

indicators.note: the banks are the edges, so only the outer letters of the next word are kept

explanation.surface: A countryman's quick spin around the riverside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' cuts FORCE to FORC and 'around' turns it to CROF. 'banks of' takes T and E from 'the'. The clue's 's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scottish smallholder who works a croft is a kind of farmer.

clue.text: Case maker's bill about to be given to customer

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill
C is short for circa, about
a user is a customer of a service

explanation.surface: A luggage manufacturer's invoice is about to go to a buyer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Case maker' looks like a maker of suitcases; it is someone who makes a case against another.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone bringing a charge against another builds a case against them.

clue.text: 'Surrender' — Romeo's words?

parts.note: Romeo is R in the NATO phonetic alphabet
enunciation is the clear speaking of words

explanation.surface: Romeo's lines as giving up, a nod to the play's lovers.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving up a right or claim formally is a surrender of it.

clue.text: Cloud over, primarily blocking sun — correct

parts.note: O is the cricket abbreviation for over

indicators.note: primarily means firstly, so only the opening letters of the next two words are used

parts.note: to correct a fault is to cure it

explanation.surface: A weather report: cloud coming over, mostly hiding the sun, is right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cloud' is a verb here, and 'primarily' gives B and S from 'blocking sun'.
explanation.definitionFit: To cloud something is to make it unclear or hide it from view, a synonym.

clue.text: He had to host ball and have a dance

indicators.note: to host is to hold a guest within, so the round letter goes inside

parts.note: he had shortens to he'd
O is shaped like a ball
to own something is to have it

explanation.surface: A man was to throw a ball and have a dance there.
explanation.definitionFit: A lively American folk gathering with square dancing is a kind of dance.

clue.text: Where everyone is painting? What about that!

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the query word goes around the synonym for painting

parts.note: eh is a way of asking what? when you missed something
painting is a form of art

explanation.surface: Someone asks where everyone is, and whether they are painting.
explanation.definitionFit: Our planet is the place every living person is found.

clue.text: Passed, having obvious knowledge about acceleration

indicators.note: about means going around, so the pair of words surrounds the abbreviation

parts.note: overt means open and obvious
ken is one's range of knowledge
A is the symbol for acceleration in physics

explanation.surface: A driver passed others, clearly knowing how to accelerate.
explanation.definitionFit: To be passed on the road by a quicker vehicle is to be overtaken.

clue.text: Where it's foolish to describe 50 as old

indicators.note: to describe is to draw around, so the jumbled letters go around the numeral
foolish means not sensible, so these letters are mixed up

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for 50

explanation.surface: It would be silly to call someone of fifty old.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to describe' means to draw a line around, an old geometry sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Former or one-time, describing what something used to be, matches old in that sense.

clue.text: Ambassador's residence in the hood?

parts.note: HE stands for His or Her Excellency, an ambassador's title
an address is where someone lives

explanation.surface: An ambassador's home in a rough neighbourhood, slang 'the hood'.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the hood' looks like American slang for a neighbourhood; it is a hood worn on the head, and the question mark marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: A hood is one example of something worn covering the head.

clue.text: Gentle, like universal parts expert?

parts.note: as means like

indicators.note: parts means separates, so the wise word splits to take the letter

parts.note: a sage is a wise expert
U is the film certificate for universal

explanation.surface: Soft, like a specialist in universal components.
explanation.definitionFit: To gentle is to calm or soothe, a verb sense matching ease.

clue.text: Bust up over first recorder

indicators.note: up means going upward in a down clue, so the word is read bottom to top

parts.note: a bust is a police raid
1st is written shortened as IST in crosswords

explanation.surface: An argument over the first musical instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recorder' looks like the instrument; it is someone recording events in a journal.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who keeps a daily journal records events in it.

clue.text: Musicians' rates very good, initially paid back

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so the turned word comes first
back means read the other way, so the synonym for paid is turned round

parts.note: a bill that is paid is met
PI is short for pious, very good in a sanctimonious way

explanation.surface: Band members' fees are very good, at first paid in arrears.
explanation.definitionFit: Speeds of music are its tempos; the Italian plural is the form musicians use.

clue.text: I secure guy X before Y's taken from unsafe Egypt

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten

indicators.note: unsafe means unstable, so the remaining letters are mixed
is taken from means removed, so the named letter comes out of the country

explanation.surface: A man called Guy is put before Y, removed from a dangerous Egypt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'guy' is a guy rope. 'Y' in the clue is the letter itself, taken out.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden or metal spike pinning a guy rope to the ground secures it.

clue.text: Outlook email regularly tends to mess up

indicators.note: regularly means every other letter of the word before it
to mess up is to jumble, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The Outlook mail program tends to scramble messages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outlook' looks like the Microsoft email program; it is a frame of mind.
explanation.definitionFit: One's attitude or way of thinking is one's outlook on life.

clue.text: Delivery company anything but bland? Vulgar

parts.note: UPS is the parcel delivery firm United Parcel Service
a tart flavour is sharp, the opposite of bland

explanation.surface: A courier firm that is far from dull, yet crude.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adjective, it describes a parvenu, pushy and lacking refinement, hence coarse.

clue.text: House party, same old nurses turning up

indicators.note: nurses means holds close, so the turned word holds the party word
turning up in a down clue means read from the bottom

parts.note: a rut is the same old routine
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A house party, the same old nurses showing up.
explanation.definitionFit: The royal dynasty of Henry VIII is a house in the sense of a ruling family.

clue.text: Secure fan without good fastener

parts.note: to secure a prize is to win it
a nut is an enthusiast or fan

explanation.surface: Win a supporter over without any good attachment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside, its old sense, not lacking.
explanation.definitionFit: A threaded nut with flat wings to turn by hand is a type of fastener.

clue.text: Prepared to look at explosive device

parts.note: to read something is to look at it
IED stands for improvised explosive device

explanation.surface: Ready to inspect a bomb.
explanation.definitionFit: Something made ready has been prepared, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Thick? I have nothing behind me

parts.note: read with 'behind me', I have it behind me means I am past it, giving I'M
something behind me is in my past
O is a zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Someone asks if they are stupid, with nothing to show for life.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the words as I'M PAST O: having nothing behind me means I have got past zero.
explanation.definitionFit: Paint applied in a thick layer on canvas is called by this painting term.

clue.text: Roughly speaking it's good to hold back fighter

indicators.note: roughly speaking means said loosely, signalling a near match in sound

parts.note: it's good to hold back is like saying it is well to wait

explanation.surface: Advice to a boxer that patience pays.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxer in the weight class between lightweight and middleweight is a fighter.
